record.paper_title: Open problems in the theory of completely positive and copositive matrices
record.original_question: Characterize the completely positive n x n matrices A for which the Drew-Johnson-Loewy cp-rank bound holds, where the bound is cpr(A) <= floor(n^2/4) and cpr(A) is the minimum number of columns in an entrywise nonnegative B satisfying A = B B^T.

evidence.quote: It is an open problem to characterize those matrices for which the DJL bound holds.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A symmetric matrix $A \in \mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ is called completely positive if there exists an entrywise nonnegative matrix $B \in \mathbb{R}^{n\times k}$ (for some $k \ge 1$) such that $A = BB^T$. The cp-rank of $A$, denoted $\operatorname{cpr}(A)$, is the smallest such $k$. Drew, Johnson, and Loewy conjectured that for every completely positive $n\times n$ matrix with $n \ge 4$ one has
$$\operatorname{cpr}(A) \le \lfloor n^2/4 \rfloor.$$
This bound (the DJL bound) is known to fail for some completely positive matrices when $n \ge 7$. Give an intrinsic characterization of the class of completely positive $n\times n$ matrices $A$ that satisfy $\operatorname{cpr}(A) \le \lfloor n^2/4 \rfloor$.
artifact.status_search_result: The DJL conjecture has been disproved in general (Bomze–Schachinger–Ullrich constructed counterexamples in every dimension n ≥ 7), but it holds in many subclasses (e.g., n ≤ 5, triangle-free graphs, matrices with PSD comparison matrix, certain inclines). A complete intrinsic characterization of the completely positive matrices for which the bound cpr(A) ≤ ⌊n²/4⌋ holds does not appear in the literature, so the characterization problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: From seven to eleven: Completely positive matrices with high cp-rank
status_evidence.snippet: Counterexamples to the DJL conjecture are constructed in every dimension n ≥ 7.
status_evidence.claim: DJL bound fails for some n×n completely positive matrices when n ≥ 7.

status_evidence.title: The DJL Conjecture for CP Matrices over Special Inclines
status_evidence.snippet: Verification of DJL-type bounds in algebraic structures other than the reals.
status_evidence.claim: DJL bound has been verified in restricted settings, indicating the general characterization remains unresolved.
